correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of 41,024 nonempty faces; both full acyclic toggle matchings verified on 210,400 Hasse incidences, with exact 39x168 and 12x141 signed integral Morse boundary matrices. Smith factors respectively 38 and 11 ones, all remaining zero; the primitive attaching maps split by Hurewicz as S^4 wedge 130 S^5. Independent full-complex mod-two boundary ranks (1,31,369,2127,6129,8078,3440,272) confirm degree-four rank 1 and degree-five rank 130 but are not used to claim integer torsion-freeness.

value.rationale: Q4 is a canonical first four-dimensional cube graph; unlike the Q3 matching complex, its ordinary matching complex has nonzero integral homology in two adjacent degrees and the exact 130-sphere multiplicity. This complete integral homotopy type on an intrinsic finite object is not derivable from previously indexed lower-dimensional examples, planar grid classifications, or general connectivity bounds, and provides a natural baseline for studying higher hypercube matching complexes.
